5205.note_text: 1. Repeatability conditions include: • the same measurement procedure; • the same operator; • the same measuring instrument, used under the same conditions; • the same location; and • repetition over a short period of time. Repeatability may be expressed quantitatively in terms of the dispersion characteristics of the results. 2. [VIM:1993, 3.6]

5203.note_text: closeness of the agreement between the results of the difference between the maximum (Amax) and  minimum (Amin) successive area measurements carried out under the same conditions of measurement R = Amax – Amin
